description:
From: Elixir Parity. User decision on fz-nhb.15 (defguard): "Faithful, as 3 tickets" (relayed 2026-11-25).

Evidence: `quote do defmacro f(x), do: x end` gives "unsupported expression prefix … Defmacro". It is the same gap that fz-mue.43 commit 1 (#893) closed for import, alias and require. Kernel.Utils.defguard emits a defmacro from a macro.

Done when: defmacro and defmacrop parse in expression position, a macro can emit one, and an oracle fixture matches Elixir on interp, run and build.
title: defmacro and defmacrop parse in expression position, so a macro can emit one, as in Elixir
